scripts.dev: node scripts/dev-app-name.mjs && node scripts/build-engine.mjs && electron-vite dev
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && node scripts/check-markdown.mjs && node scripts/check-store-digest.mjs && node scripts/check-node-kinds.mjs && node scripts/check-store-names.mjs && node scripts/check-store-shapes.mjs && node scripts/check-kdf.mjs && node scripts/check-signing.mjs && node scripts/check-git.mjs && node scripts/check-cli-path.mjs && node scripts/check-agent-session.mjs && node scripts/check-attachments.mjs && node scripts/check-tooltalk.mjs
scripts.pack:mac: node scripts/build-engine.mjs darwin && electron-vite build && cross-env ZYVROD_BIN=zyvrod electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.pack:win: node scripts/build-engine.mjs windows && electron-vite build && cross-env ZYVROD_BIN=zyvrod.exe electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/build-engine.mjs darwin && electron-vite build && cross-env ZYVROD_BIN=zyvrod electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/build-engine.mjs windows && electron-vite build && cross-env ZYVROD_BIN=zyvrod.exe electron-builder --win
